metadata.name: RISE Motordrome — Grand Prix layout
metadata.description: Anticlockwise 5.89 km circuit with 17 corners beside Lake Kidogo at Bugesera, the Grand Prix lap: the outer line through Turn 1, the loop over the ridge and the outer hairpin at Turn 8. My reading of the official design from its published renders and figures, set on the site's real ground: plateau pit straight, the banked Bowl, the long descent to the West Hill hairpin and the esses along the lake. 78 m elevation range, 191 m climbed per lap.
metadata.author: built in Blender from the official renders (scripts/rwanda-official)
